findings.location: Article paragraph beginning “Remember, the word desire…” (Psalm 78:29–31 quotation)
findings.source_quote: “So they did eat, and were well filled: for he gave them their own desire; They were not estranged from their lust.”
findings.suggested_fix: Translate the quotation faithfully as printed, preserving the distinction that they were not separated from their lust/desire (for example, “وہ اپنی ہوس سے الگ نہ ہوئے تھے”).
findings.translation_quote: “پس وہ کھا کر خوب آسودہ ہوئے کیونکہ اُس نے اُنہیں اُن کی مراد دی۔ وہ اپنی ہوس سے باز نہ آئے تھے”

findings.location: Article paragraph beginning “Another good example…” (1 Samuel 8:5–7 quotation)
findings.source_quote: “Hearken unto the voice of the people in all that they say unto thee”
findings.suggested_fix: Render “Hearken unto the voice” as “لوگوں کی آواز سن” or an equivalent faithful Urdu phrase, rather than saying to obey their request.
